# pk-annotator

> Dev-only browser overlay for Vite and React apps. Pick elements, draw, capture screenshots, record interactions, and send requests to a coding agent through the bundled pka-mcp stdio MCP server. Requests include source context for picked elements and screenshots; recordings and debug data can be attached. Save several marks to send together, or send separate requests in succession. Agent replies appear on the page. npm package: pk-annotator (MIT).

- [Agent setup guide](https://pk-annotator.paulbkim.dev/agents.md): step-by-step instructions for a coding agent to install and connect pk-annotator in a project
- [Installer](https://pk-annotator.paulbkim.dev/install.sh): shell script that adds the dev dependency and registers pka-mcp with Claude Code
